name: OmniDocBench
intro: OmniDocBench 是面向多样 PDF 文档解析的细粒度基准。它从 20 多万份 PDF 中经视觉聚类和属性平衡筛出 981 页，覆盖九类文档、19 类版面元素、15 个属性标签和超过 10 万条标注，并支持端到端、逐任务和逐属性评测。
build_method: 视觉聚类抽样, 半自动预标注, 人工逐字符修订, 专家质检
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
task_type: 文档解析, OCR, 版面分析
eval_feature: 端到端评测, 逐任务评测, 逐属性评测
scale: 981个PDF页面, 9种文档类型, 19类版面元素, 15个属性标签, 10万+标注
build_method_en: Visual Clustering and Sampling, Semi-automatic Pre-annotation, Character-level Human Revision, Expert Quality Control
eval_feature_en: End-to-end Evaluation, Task-level Evaluation, Attribute-level Evaluation
intro_en: OmniDocBench is a fine-grained benchmark for diverse PDF document parsing. It selects 981 pages from more than 200,000 PDFs through visual clustering and attribute balancing, covers nine document types, 19 layout-element classes, 15 attribute labels, and over 100,000 annotations, and supports end-to-end, task-level, and attribute-level evaluation.
scale_en: 981 PDF pages, 9 document types, 19 layout classes, 15 attribute labels, 100K+ annotations

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.07626 and the official OpenDataLab/OmniDocBench project. The diagrams preserve the collection of more than 200,000 PDFs from Common Crawl, Google, Baidu, and internal sources; ResNet-50 visual features and ten-center Faiss clustering; 6,000 annotation candidates; page-attribute balancing to 981 pages across nine document types; LayoutLMv3, PaddleOCR, UniMERNet, and GPT-4o pre-annotations; 19 layout classes, reading order and element relationships, Unicode text, LaTeX formulae, and HTML/LaTeX tables; character-level human correction; CDM rendering checks and three-researcher review; the release of more than 100,000 annotations and 15 attribute labels; Markdown preprocessing, adjacency and fuzzy matching, ignore rules, and text, table, formula, and reading-order metrics.
